description: Project the Agent Surface for any API — a deterministic, provenance-carrying, safety-checked call graph an agent traverses to get the call right the first time. Ingest an OpenAPI (or recover one from docs), get first-call-correct MCP tools, chain the calls agents get wrong, and verify doc claims against the live API before they fire. Apache-2.0.
rules: gecko-surf is the API comprehension layer for agents: it derives the Agent Surface (a deterministic call graph) above an OpenAPI, never a payment rail or a marketplace.
Gecko is the control plane, never the data plane — it stores the API surface and correctness metadata, never response payloads, user data, or secrets.
Onboard any API with `gecko add <api>`; serve one over MCP with `gecko <openapi-url>`; verify doc claims against reality with `gecko verify-docs <spec>`.
Gecko composes on top of OpenAPI (input) and MCP (transport) and Context7 (a docs input) — it does not replace them.

Gecko is safe by construction: it treats every ingested API surface (specs, docs, tool descriptions, images) as untrusted and quarantines prompt-injection or tool-poisoning before the agent reads it, and injects auth at call time so the agent never holds API keys.
